report.summary: All 36 tagged claims are fully supported by the cited DRHP excerpts. The only untagged claim—that the company does not sell directly to end users—is a reasonable inference but lacks an explicit source; it does not involve a number, date, name, or segment, so it does not raise the blocking count. The report's sourcing is sound and no critical errors were found.
